instruction.german: Read the story and check your answers to exercises 1 and 2.

parts:
Anna wanted to buy a special birthday present for her grandfather. She went to a large department store in town. She looked at some beautiful wallets and some lovely belts, but they

were very expensive. Then suddenly she had a great idea.


She went home and found a big notebook. She filled it with photographs of her grandparents, and she wrote little stories about her favourite family memories.


The next day she gave the notebook to her grandfather. He was very surprised and happy.

‘This is the best birthday present ever!’ he said.
